messages:
taylor: dropped a tiny prototype for 'Jumplinks' in the left rail — think pinned deep-links + a compact rail that surfaces per-page anchors. this is mostly about route hygiene and breadcrumb behavior. attaching rough routes for discussion

jess: high-level 👍. two quick asks: 1) users should be able to copy a stable permalink that skips ephemeral UI state, 2) when they paste a link it should land them in the exact panel with clear context

omar: routing sanity: prefer canonical server-visible path + optional hash for client UI. e.g. canonical /models/123/metrics and then #panel=latency for the open subpanel. redirect legacy routes to canonical in the server layer to avoid broken runbooks

li: a11y & focus: when arriving via a jumplink, move focus to the revealed panel heading and announce via aria-live "Opened metrics for Model Foo". avoid focusing interactive controls immediately — that surprises keyboard users

jess: breadcrumb UX q: should the breadcrumb reflect the canonical path or include the panel? idea: show "Model • Foo" as main crumbs and append a small pill for the panel (keyboard focusable). pill reads "metrics" and is removable/clickable to get back to resource root

omar: permalink policy: by default copy canonical path. add a toggle "include UI state" for hash/query when users want exact replication. that prevents spammy analytics and keeps links robust across UI tweaks

li: keyboard order: Jumplinks first, then nav. ensure skip link target updates on deep-link navigation (so screenreader users can skip directly to the main content that changed)

taylor: sample routes in prototype:
```
/models/123
/models/123/metrics#panel=latency
/workloads/deployment/d-9/instances
```

jess: small copy suggestion: label the rail section "Jumplinks" (short) with tooltip "Pin or share a view". for pinned items show a small icon and the full path on hover. UI text for the permalink toggle: "Include tab & panel state"

omar: telemetry note: capture link_source: jumplink|breadcrumb|editor to measure adoption. also capture if permalink included UI state (boolean)

li: accessibility nit: ensure color contrast of the pill and focus ring meets AA. also aria-expanded on rail toggles and aria-pressed for pin buttons

jess: edge case: if a resource is moved/renamed, pinned jumplinks should either redirect or show a helpful deprecation message with the new location. we should maintain a redirect table for 6-12 months

taylor: i'll update the figma with the focus flows and add a small RFC section on redirects + telemetry. will wire the permalink toggle into the composer and add QA checks: landing focus, breadcrumb pill behaviour, redirect alias, copy behavior. thanks all :rocket:

product-bot: prototype updated: https://figma.redwood/jumplinks-rail-v1 (comments enabled)
